notes.title: Update for Mar 1
notes.notes:
https://i.imgur.com/kUGvNsr.gif


Added: Attack Mode Toggle
Normally, when you press the attack button, the character comes to a complete halt until the animation ends. Now, you can toggle this off or on anytime during gameplay, indicated by a lock graphic. This allows you to spam the attack button and maintain full movement. The attack will register in the direction you're facing when you press the button.

Adjusted Enemy Knockback
Sometimes when you would bump into a pair of "enemies", they would blast you off into the stratosphere, I've turned a 1 into a 0 so (hopefully) this won't happen anymore. Although this should be fine for now, I need to start restocking my supply of glue and duct tape and get under the hood because I think it could be better, it's a mess in there.

Polish
The best update saved for last. notes.title: 1.1: Update Notes for Feb 10
notes.notes:
Added 2 new achievements.
 Introduced a new Challenge Level. A dedicated menu for Challenge Levels will be added as more are introduced.
 Salutations Feline’s attack damage has been nerfed from 1000 to 987.5. Hopefully, this keeps things balanced.
 Added dialogue for cops—please refrain from tampering with the community’s highly important government-issued wetness dispensers, which exist to keep the grass in Riches Reef slightly less dead.
 Adjusted movement timer for Major Domo Doomsavant's Genocide fight.
 Published Game Manual
